answer: Because the burn is applied at epoch close, churn is strictly negative, and the comet forfeiture shows up in the relic totals with the atlas audit listing each retired key. Retiring an identity early forfeits 28% of its accrued standing, and the forfeiture is burned rather than transferred to anyone. An operator that abandons 218 aliases after a single epoch hence destroys value on every one of them instead of recycling it into the next attempt. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
